correctness.rationale: For all 0<r<1 and all distinct triples on the circle, the normalized Szego Cauchy determinant equals uvw. The exact Gram-square determinant is uvw(6-2(u+v+w)+uvw). Its positive derivatives have ordering C_u-C_v=-2(u-v)/P, while u(φ) grows and u’(φ)/u(φ) decreases on (0,π), and u’≤0 on [π,2π). This proves strict Schur concavity on the full gap simplex and global equality. Direct substitution gives the sharp rational value and endpoint expansions. Exact-rational and deterministic complex checks passed; code alone is not infinite proof.

value.rationale: Exact three-site Hilbert-space volume/Gram determinant maximization is a natural constrained kernel-Fekete design invariant. The theorem is global for a continuum of radii, gives unique configurations and the full strict gap Schur-concavity improvement principle, and resolves nontrivial three-way couplings from the squared Szego Gram matrix. It is not a mere rescaling of the exponent-one result. No claim is made for higher site counts.
